summary.what_it_does: QuizB.ai is a web app for generating quiz questions with AI. Users pick a template or a topic, then choose grade and subject options to tailor the output. The page mentions template generation, topic generation, and a question bank management section. It also lists an API document and tutorials. The page text is mostly navigation and marketing, so specifics about output format and question types are not stated.
notable: Grade and subject selection for tailoring questions
